```{r setup}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath("~/qbio_490/analysis_data"))
```

```{r}
library(BiocManager)
library(TCGAbiolinks)
library(maftools)

# Saves an image of an R command and its printed output (for the Brightspace "screenshot" deliverable)
shot_dir <- normalizePath("~/qbio_490/part2_screenshots", mustWork = FALSE)
dir.create(shot_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
save_output_png <- function(code_lines, obj, file) {
  old <- options(width = 160); on.exit(options(old))
  lines <- c(paste0("> ", code_lines), capture.output(print(obj)))
  lines <- substr(lines, 1, 160)
  png(file.path(shot_dir, file), width = 1500, height = 40 + 15 * length(lines), res = 100, bg = "white")
  par(mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0)); plot.new()
  text(0.005, 1 - (seq_along(lines) - 0.5) / length(lines), lines, adj = 0, family = "mono", cex = 0.62)
  dev.off()
}
```

Clinical data

```{r}
clin_query <- GDCquery(project = "TCGA-BRCA",
                       data.category = "Clinical",
                       data.type = "Clinical Supplement",
                       data.format = 'BCR Biotab')
GDCdownload(clin_query)
clinical.BCRtab.all <- GDCprepare(clin_query)
clinic <- clinical.BCRtab.all$clinical_patient_brca[-c(1,2),]
```

```{r}
#Rei Shuen Ng
head(clinic)
save_output_png(c("#Rei Shuen Ng", "head(clinic)"), head(clinic), "1_head_clinic.png")
```

Mutation data

```{r}
colnames(clinic)[ colnames(clinic) == "bcr_patient_barcode" ] <- "Tumor_Sample_Barcode"

maf_query <- GDCquery(
  project = "TCGA-BRCA",
  data.category = "Simple Nucleotide Variation",
  access = "open",
  data.type = "Masked Somatic Mutation",
  workflow.type = "Aliquot Ensemble Somatic Variant Merging and Masking"
)
GDCdownload(maf_query, method = "api", files.per.chunk = 100)
maf <- GDCprepare(maf_query)
maf_object <- read.maf(maf = maf,
                       clinicalData = clinic,
                       isTCGA = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#Rei Shuen Ng
maf_head <- tryCatch(head(maf_object), error = function(e) head(maf_object@data))
maf_head
save_output_png(c("#Rei Shuen Ng", "head(maf_object)"), maf_head, "2_head_maf_object.png")
```

RNA-seq data

```{r}
rna_query <- GDCquery(project = "TCGA-BRCA",
                      data.category = "Transcriptome Profiling",
                      data.type = "Gene Expression Quantification",
                      workflow.type = "STAR - Counts")
# Download in small batches and retry: large batches sometimes come back as an error instead of a tar archive.
# Files already downloaded are skipped on each retry.
for (attempt in 1:15) {
  ok <- tryCatch({ GDCdownload(rna_query, method = "api", files.per.chunk = 10); TRUE },
                 error = function(e) { message("Download attempt ", attempt, " failed: ", conditionMessage(e)); FALSE })
  if (ok) break
  Sys.sleep(10)
}
rna_se <- GDCprepare(rna_query)
```

```{r}
#Rei Shuen Ng
rna_head <- head(rna_se)
rna_head
save_output_png(c("#Rei Shuen Ng", "head(rna_se)"), rna_head, "3_head_rna_se.png")
```
